crossRefs.note: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”
For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven, and gives life to the world.”
For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.
I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary…
I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
The Lord Yahweh’s Spirit is on me, because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to…
“Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep, and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the…
Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”
For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”
In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord…
But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John, for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the…
I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished.” He bowed his head, and gave up his spirit.
looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross…

translations.web: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.
